course: Helpful to studio
It was a very useful class with important clues about environmental technology and other kind of neccecitiies in a building.

The applications and different methods of environmental systems are essential for an architect. However some systems become mostly theoretical in real life uses. The overall goal of the class is nice.

ARCH 342 homeworks are always given in our most stressful times, especially in the jury weeks and when we have many other assignments from studios. So the students has to do the homeworks in a very fast and stresful way. If we have more time to research, draw and design for ARCH 342 homeworks, it would be more efficient.

The course aims to teach you some useful information but it ceases to do...This situation has nothing to do with the instructors though. Both Glenn and Jesus are really experienced and wise teachers. The problem is that we have no single tangible, acceptable course source to study. At the beginning of the semester all the students are advised to go find a book called "Sun Wind and Light" but we can neither reach a source to buy the book in Bilkent or anywhere close nor find a reason to buy it, since even the teachers do not prefer to proceed the course based on the book. I sometimes think even they don't have an access to the book. So we basically end up with either carrying the lessons from open internet sources in class and also study from them at home or some slide shows given which have only few useful information and a wide range of unnecessary images. I think that's  a very urgent problem that Bilkent Department of Architecture has to solve. I am going to graduate in a year and will be working in a company and all the information I have learned about environmental systems, MEP strategies is going to be based on some internet video, a blog or a slideshow? Just please arrange a course material that the course systematically follows. I am ready to buy one...
